SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.title: Six Stones by the Water
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.IN: Six stones lie in the shallows, humming with the ebb. Three of them are within reach. A shard taken now will last until the end of the act.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.TA: The stone is warm in your hand. The tide will take it back when the act ends.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.LE: You walk away. The stones keep humming.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.title: Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.INITIA: A quiet shrine of one of the Celestials. A priest tends the candles and sells relics of the god's set: an Amulet for 120 gold and a Robe for 150.
You already carry this god's blessing.
The Celestials do not answer the Apostate.
Donate [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold: righteousness +1 step (once per act).
Requires [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold; once per act; impossible for the Outcast's chosen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BLESSE: Warmth spreads through you. Anything else?
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.REDEEM: The priest nods. A weight lifts from your soul.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BOUGHT: The priest wraps the relic in clean linen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.ROBBED: You run, the offering bowl clinking. Somewhere a candle goes out.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.title: Dark Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.I: An altar of black stone. Two Princes of the Abyss offer their gifts — each with a Price. A pact makes you Apostate — unless an Ashborn accepts a gift of the Tribunal.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.A: The pact is sealed. The Prince is watching.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.title: Beast Blood
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.pages.I: A wounded wolf the size of a horse watches you from the brush. Its eyes are almost human.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.pages.A: The fever passes by dawn. Something else stays.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.title: Whisper from the Urn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.pages.I: An urn of black clay whispers your name and offers a pact: power over the dead for a piece of your life.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.pages.A: The whisper falls silent. Your heart beats a little slower.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.title: Vigil
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL: An empty chapel with one candle still burning. A night of prayer here could change you.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
Only the Righteous may keep this vigil.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.pages.ACCEPTE: At dawn the candle is still burning. So are you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DEEP_HEART_EVENT.title: Heart of the Deep
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DEEP_HEART_EVENT.pages.IN: A dwarven automaton lies broken in the dark, its clockwork core still ticking.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.title: Feast in the Crypt
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.pages.I: Pale nobles feast in a crypt and invite you to their table. The wine is very red.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.pages.A: You wake in a coffin. You are no longer cold.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.title: Phylactery
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.pages.IN: A soul jar on an altar of bone. A Herald could finish the rite here.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.pages.AC: Your heart stops. You do not.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.I: An Ordinator serves only the Tribunal.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROZEN_PILGRIM_EVENT.page: A pilgrim sits frozen against a cairn, still clutching his purse. Snow has filled his open eyes.
Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. Righteousness +1 step (once per act).
The coins are warm from his last breath. You try not to think about it.
You pile stones over him. The wind dies down for a moment, as if in thanks.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARROW_SEAL_EVENT.title: The Barrow Seal
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARROW_SEAL_EVENT.pages.I: A round stone door bears three rings of carved beasts. In the centre is a socket shaped like a claw.
Spend a [gold]Claw Key[/gold]. Gain a relic.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARROW_SEAL_EVENT.pages.U: The rings turn with a grinding sigh. Inside, a jarl's offering waits under the frost.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARROW_SEAL_EVENT.pages.F: The door gives way and so does your shoulder. A few coins spill from the dark.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST_ALTAR_EVENT.title: Altar of Frost
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST_ALTAR_EVENT.pages.I: Blue ice has grown over an altar to some forgotten winter god. It hums when you come near.
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] max HP. [gold]Frosty[/gold] enchantment on an Attack.
Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. The next [gold]{Warmth}[/gold] fights are without [gold]Chill[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST_ALTAR_EVENT.pages.B: The steel drinks the cold. Your fingers never quite warm again.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST_ALTAR_EVENT.pages.M: Water runs down the altar like tears. The air feels a little kinder.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DRAUGR_WAKE_EVENT.title: Draugr Wake
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DRAUGR_WAKE_EVENT.pages.I: Draugr sit around a long table, frozen mid-toast. One empty seat. A full horn of mead in front of it.
Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] max HP. Add [gold]Decay[/gold] to your deck.
Raise a horn to the fallen
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DRAUGR_WAKE_EVENT.pages.F: The mead is cold as the grave and twice as strong. Something of the table follows you out.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DRAUGR_WAKE_EVENT.pages.T: The draugr do not move. But when you leave, every horn is lowered.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURIAL_URNS_EVENT.title: Burial Urns
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURIAL_URNS_EVENT.pages.I: Rows of clay urns line a crypt wall. Some rattle with coins. Some rattle with something else.
Maybe [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold, maybe [gold]{Dust}[/gold] Grave Dust, maybe a trap ([red]{Hp}[/red] HP).
Gain [gold]{AllGold}[/gold] gold and [gold]{AllDust}[/gold] Grave Dust. Add [gold]Regret[/gold] to your deck.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURIAL_URNS_EVENT.pages.O: Old coins spill across the floor.
Fine grey dust, perfect for an alchemist. You scoop it up.
A dart hisses out of the wall.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURIAL_URNS_EVENT.pages.A: Shards everywhere. The dead will remember who did this.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SNOWBOUND_SLED_EVENT.page: A merchant's sled lies on its side, half buried in snow. The horse is long gone.
Gain a potion and [gold]{Sorrel}[/gold] Yellow Sorrel.
Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. The next fight is without [gold]Chill[/gold].
Frozen bread, a corked bottle, a pouch of herbs. The merchant won't miss them.
The fire roars. For one night the Barrows are not cold.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BROKEN_GOLEM_EVENT.title: The Broken Golem Asks for a Key
A brass golem slumps against a pipe. It points at the keyhole in its chest and clicks politely.
Buy a key and wind it
Pay [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold. Gain tier II–III equipment.
The golem whirs upright, bows, and hands you something from its storage hatch.
Gears, springs, a little brass soul. You keep what is useful.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEAM_VALVE_EVENT.title: Steam Valve
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEAM_VALVE_EVENT.pages.I: A rusted valve shrieks as scalding steam floods the corridor. The wheel is red-hot.
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. The next [gold]{Relief}[/gold] fights are without [gold]Overheat[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEAM_VALVE_EVENT.pages.C: Your palms blister, but the pipes fall silent along the whole level.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEAM_VALVE_EVENT.pages.B: Warm, wet, almost pleasant. The Dwemer knew how to build a bathhouse.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BRASS_ARCHIVE_EVENT.title: Brass Archive
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BRASS_ARCHIVE_EVENT.pages: Thin brass plates stamped with schematics fill a hall of shelves. Some still glow.
Your head aches with angles. Then, suddenly, they make sense.
A small improvement, but an elegant one.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COAST_RAIDERS_EVENT.title: Coast Raiders
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COAST_RAIDERS_EVENT.pages: Raiders from the coast have barricaded the tunnel. Their leader names a toll and grins.
They scatter. Their purse does not.
"Pleasure doing business." The leader hands over something clearly stolen from a Dwemer ruin.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AUTOMATON_FORGE_EVENT.pag: An automated forge still works, hammering nothing on an empty anvil.
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. [gold]Breathing[/gold] enchantment on an Attack.
The hammer catches your hand once. The blade comes out lighter than air.
What goes in is not what comes out.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CLOCKWORK_ORACLE_EVENT.pa: A brass head in a glass box. A slot for coins. A sign: "THE FUTURE — 25".
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. Gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold and [gold]{Crystal}[/gold] Storm Crystals.
The head whirs and spits out a card. "YOUR FUTURE," it says.
Glass, sparks, coins. The head keeps predicting from the floor.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASQUERADE_EVENT.title: Masquerade
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASQUERADE_EVENT.pages.IN: Masked guests whirl through a velvet hall. The hostess, in silver, holds out a hand to you.
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] max HP. Gain a rare relic.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASQUERADE_EVENT.pages.MA: Under a stranger's face you pick a stranger's pocket. Nobody notices.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MASQUERADE_EVENT.pages.DA: Her hands are cold. At the end of the dance she kisses your wrist and leaves a gift.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLOOD_FOUNTAIN_EVENT.page: In the courtyard a marble fountain runs red. It smells of iron and roses.
It tastes better than it should. That worries you.
The steel comes out darker and keener.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COUNTS_DICE_EVENT.title: The Count's Dice
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COUNTS_DICE_EVENT.pages.I: A count in a ruffled collar rolls bone dice across a table. "One throw. Gold or blood — your choice."
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COUNTS_DICE_EVENT.pages.W: Double sixes. The count laughs and pays.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COUNTS_DICE_EVENT.pages.L: Snake eyes. Your gold joins the pile.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-COUNTS_DICE_EVENT.pages.B: He licks the blood from the dice and slides a trinket across the table.
"Delicious," says the count. You get nothing else.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THRALL_MARKET_EVENT.title: Thrall Market
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THRALL_MARKET_EVENT.pages: Pale-eyed thralls stand in chains under the gallery. A steward reads out prices.
Pay [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP, upgrade a card. Righteousness +1 step (once per act).
They scatter into the night. One stays long enough to bind your wounds and show you a trick.
The steward pays without looking at you. Neither do the thralls.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIND_MIRROR_EVENT.title: Mirror Without a Reflection
A tall mirror in a gilt frame shows the room behind you. It does not show you.
The glass cuts you. Something you were carrying stays inside the frame.
For a moment you see yourself — from the outside, the way they see you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-NIGHT_CARRIAGE_EVENT.page: A black carriage stops beside you. The coachman has no shadow. "Going up to the castle?"
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. Gain [gold]{Loot}[/gold] gold. Righteousness −1 step.
Velvet seats, a quiet ride. You doze for the first time in days.
The passengers bite. But their jewellery is real.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_EXAM_EVENT.title: The Star Exam
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_EXAM_EVENT.pages.INI: An examiner of the Tower blocks the stair. "No one climbs higher without proving their school."
Requires Destruction mastery {Need}+. Destruction mastery +1, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold.
Requires Restoration mastery {Need}+. Restoration mastery +1, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold.
Requires Alteration mastery {Need}+. Alteration mastery +1, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold.
Requires Conjuration mastery {Need}+. Conjuration mastery +1, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold.
Requires Illusion mastery {Need}+. Illusion mastery +1, gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold.
Pay [gold]{Bribe}[/gold] gold. Your weakest school +1. Righteousness −1 step.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_EXAM_EVENT.pages.PAS: The examiner nods once and steps aside. "Adequate." From him, that is high praise.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_EXAM_EVENT.pages.CRA: You pass. You do not feel proud.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LEY_WELL_EVENT.title: Ley Well
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LEY_WELL_EVENT.pages.INIT: Raw magic wells up from a crack in the floor, bright as liquid starlight.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LEY_WELL_EVENT.pages.DRAN: Sparks crawl along the steel and settle in.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LEY_WELL_EVENT.pages.FILL: The flask glows faintly in your pack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BROKEN_ORRERY_EVENT.title: Broken Orrery
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BROKEN_ORRERY_EVENT.pages: A great orrery lies smashed, its planets scattered across the observatory floor.
The last planet clicks into place, and a hidden drawer slides open.
Fine glass. Someone below will pay well for it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RENEGADE_APPRENTICE_EVENT: A runaway apprentice clutches a stolen grimoire. "I'll sell you a page. Just don't tell the masters."
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. Choose 1 of [gold]{Spells}[/gold] spells. Righteousness −1 step.
The ink is still wet. He runs before you can change your mind.
He fights back with a spark or two. Not enough.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MIRROR_LIBRARY_EVENT.page: Every book here is written backwards. A mirror on each lectern makes them readable.
Your eyes burn. Your hands remember.
The page curls into blue ash. You feel lighter.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_CARTOGRAPHER_EVENT.p: An old cartographer maps the sky from a balcony. "Help me with the sums, or buy a treatise. I have no time for idlers."
Pay [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold. Gain a mastery treatise.
The treatise is dense, annotated and slightly singed.
By midnight the sums come out. He pays exactly what he promised, not a coin more.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WHISPERING_RIFT_EVENT.pag: A crack in the hive wall opens onto nothing. Something in the nothing is whispering.
Gain a relic. Add [gold]Regret[/gold] to your deck.
Your hand comes back holding something. It is colder than it should be.
The rift closes on a scream. It takes a piece of you with it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIVE_AMBER_EVENT.title: Hive Amber
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIVE_AMBER_EVENT.pages.IN: A lump of amber the size of a shield. Something is trapped inside — a card, of all things.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIVE_AMBER_EVENT.pages.CR: The amber splits cleanly. The card inside is still warm.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIVE_AMBER_EVENT.pages.GA: Sticky, fragrant and very useful to an alchemist.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASH_PILGRIM_EVENT.title: The Ash Pilgrim
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASH_PILGRIM_EVENT.pages.I: A pilgrim walks through the hive in robes of ash, leaving grey footprints. He asks for alms — or company.
Pay [gold]{Alms}[/gold] gold. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. Righteousness +1 step (once per act).
Walk with him through the ash
Lose [red]{Hp}[/red] HP. Gain [gold]{Salt}[/gold] Ash Salt. [gold]Flaming[/gold] enchantment on an Attack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASH_PILGRIM_EVENT.pages.G: He blesses you with a smudge of ash on the brow. It does not wash off for days.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASH_PILGRIM_EVENT.pages.F: You walk through fire together. When it ends, your weapon is still burning.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FALLEN_HERALD_EVENT.title: The Fallen Herald
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FALLEN_HERALD_EVENT.pages: A herald of the Spire lies dead on the steps, his banner still upright in his fist.
Gain tier IV–V equipment. Righteousness −1 step.
The banner is heavy. You carry it anyway.
It fits well. Better than it should.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VOID_MERCHANT_EVENT.title: Void Merchant
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VOID_MERCHANT_EVENT.pages: A merchant made of folded shadow spreads out wares that hurt to look at. "I take payment in kind."
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] max HP. Gain a rare relic.
He takes it neatly. It barely hurts. That is the worst part.
You forget something. You are not sure what. You are richer.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LAST_CAMPFIRE_EVENT.title: The Last Campfire
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LAST_CAMPFIRE_EVENT.pages: A small fire burns among the ruins, tended by no one. The Abyss has not reached it yet.
Heal as if at a camp.
You sleep. Nothing comes for you. It feels like a miracle.
The whetstone sings in the quiet.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ABANDONED_MULE_EVENT.page: A mule stands by the road under a full pack, chewing on a dry thistle. Its owner is nowhere to be seen.
Gain a [gold]Pack Mule[/gold]: +[gold]{Burden}[/gold] Burden, the camp chest is open at any shop counter.
The mule looks at you, sighs, and follows. It has clearly done this before.
Coins wrapped in a rag, a bundle of herbs. The mule wanders off into the brush.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MULE_AMBUSH_EVENT.title: Ambush
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MULE_AMBUSH_EVENT.pages.I: Arrows hiss out of the dark. The bandits aren't after you — they want the mule and everything it carries.
Lose your [gold]Pack Mule[/gold] and half of the camp chest.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MULE_AMBUSH_EVENT.pages.D: You stand over the mule until the last bandit runs. It nuzzles your wound.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MULE_AMBUSH_EVENT.pages.B: The leader weighs the purse, grins and whistles. The arrows stop.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MULE_AMBUSH_EVENT.pages.A: You run. Behind you, the mule's cry and the sound of tearing sacks.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_CANDLE_EVENT.title: Candle in the Crypt
Deep in a sealed crypt a single candle burns on a grave slab. Its flame does not flicker — and in it you see the grey face of your Memory Stone.
You cup the flame in your palms. Far away, at the start of the act, the Stone grows a little warmer.
The candle gutters out. Old grave wax still fetches a fair price.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIBRARY_EVENT.title: Library
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.INITI: Dusty shelves climb into the dark. A blind archivist dips his quill and waits for your request.
Learn [gold]1[/gold] of [gold]{Spells}[/gold] spells your mastery allows.
Pay [gold]{Copy}[/gold] gold: the spell of your first scroll goes into your deck for good.
Pay [gold]{Treatise}[/gold] gold for a mastery treatise.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.STUDI: Hours pass in silence. The words of the spell now live behind your eyes.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.COPIE: The archivist's quill scratches the scroll's words into your memory. The parchment crumbles.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.BOUGH: The archivist wraps the treatise in oilcloth. "Read it twice," he says.
